summary: Playboy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 annual meeting results and approval of an equity plan amendment increasing authorized shares by 10 million. The filing is a routine current report covering director elections, ratification of auditor, say-on-pay vote, and postponement authority. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or tender offer is present. Since the filing solely entails standard governance matters and a share reserve increase, it does not constitute a special situation.
